meta.description: Structured traits for accurate, diverse character bibles in Grok Imagine prompts. Use with the madlibs template in README.md and stories JSONs for hominin-accurate anatomy, skin science, hair, and body morphology. Combine with style_presets/ for full prompt.
meta.usage: Fill {placeholders} in the Character Bible block. Repeat verbatim for consistency across image/video generations and story beats.

face_shapes: oval (balanced proportions, slightly wider at cheekbones, soft jaw)
round (soft curves, equal width and length, full cheeks)
square (strong angular jaw, wide forehead and jawline equal width)
heart-shaped (wide forehead and cheekbones tapering to pointed chin)
diamond (high prominent cheekbones, narrow forehead and jaw)
oblong/rectangular (long face, similar width forehead to jaw, high forehead)
triangular (narrow forehead widening to strong square jaw)
inverted triangle (wide forehead and cheekbones, narrow pointed chin)
pear/teardrop (narrow forehead, wider jaw and full lower face)

anthropological variants: robust Neanderthal-like with heavy supraorbital ridge and occipital bun; gracile sapiens with high vaulted cranium and reduced brow; archaic Homo erectus with low flat forehead and projecting face

scalp_hair.color_base: eumelanin dominant black/brown or pheomelanin red/blonde with dispersion %
scalp_hair.length_and_style: short cropped, shoulder length, long flowing, tied in specific cultural styles

facial_hair.micro_fuzz: vellus peach fuzz across cheeks, upper lip, chin for soft youthful or female presentation; fine vellus on forehead and sideburns
facial_hair.macro_terminal: beard growth patterns (full, goatee, mustache, sideburns, patchy), density, curl pattern matching scalp, stubble length for 5-o'clock shadow realism

hair.upper_torso_hair: chest hair density (none to heavy terminal), abdominal trail, shoulder/back micro fuzz vs macro patches
hair.under_arms: axillary hair density and length (micro vellus to thick terminal curls), often trimmed or natural per cultural styling
hair.lower_torso_legs: leg hair (macro terminal on shins/calves/thighs in males, lighter vellus in many ancestries), pubic hair patterns (triangular, diamond, etc.)
hair.micro_macro_fuzz_hair_notes: Distinguish vellus (fine, short, lightly pigmented 'fuzz' covering most body for subtle texture and light refraction) vs terminal (thicker, longer, pigmented 'hair' in androgen-sensitive areas). Include in prompts for subsurface realism and 'natural skin' feel under different lighting/LUTs.

overall_somatotypes_and_anthropological: ectomorph: tall, lean, long limbs, narrow frame (common in equatorial Nilotic ancestries, high crural index from hominin savanna adaptations)
mesomorph: athletic, broad shoulders, muscular torso, balanced (many Eurasian and recent admixture builds)
endomorph: softer, wider hips/waist, higher body fat storage capacity (adaptations in certain cold or feast-famine hominin lines)
steatopygous: pronounced gluteal fat deposits (Khoisan and some African ancestries, evolutionary fat storage)
robust archaic: short stature, barrel chest, thick bones, short limbs (Neanderthal-derived)
gracile modern: slender build, long legs relative to torso (Out-of-Africa sapiens)
body_shapes_and_proportions.upper_torso: shoulder width vs hip ratio, pectoral development, ribcage flare, waist taper, latissimus/upper back width; male vs female dimorphism in shoulder girdle
body_shapes_and_proportions.lower_torso: hip width (wide for childbirth in sapiens females), glute shape (round, square, heart), thigh thickness, calf definition, leg length proportion to torso (intermembral index variations across hominin tree)
body_shapes_and_proportions.limb_details: arm length/forearm vs upper arm, hand/foot size relative, joint prominence (knobby vs smooth from ancestry/activity)

styling_and_presentation.hair_styling: culturally specific (cornrows, locs, topknot, shaved patterns, oiled and slicked for reflectance)
styling_and_presentation.body_styling: groomed vs natural body hair (shaved underarms/legs for smooth subsurface show, or retained for texture), skin treatments (oiled for sheen and refraction, ashen for dry look), posture and muscle tone from lifestyle (hunter-gatherer lean vs agricultural stocky)
styling_and_presentation.relation_to_clothing: how body shape interacts with draping fabric, muscle/fat distribution affecting silhouette under period or modern styling

hominin_tree_relation.description: Specify admixture percentages and trait expression for genetic 'realism' and diversity. Tie physical features back to evolutionary branches for prompt accuracy and to avoid generic 'diverse' descriptions.
examples: 85% recent Homo sapiens sapiens (East African origin) + 15% Neanderthal introgression: manifests as robust brow ridge contribution, slightly receding forehead, thicker nasal bridge, higher muscle mass potential, cold-climate skin adaptations with lower eumelanin baseline but high dispersion capability
95%+ Homo sapiens with minimal archaic: high forehead, gracile face, variable skin melanin calibrated to latitude (high % for equatorial UV protection with dense basal layer packing)
Denisovan admixture (2-5% in some Oceanian/Asian lines): adaptations for high altitude/UV including altered skin vascularity and melanin patterning, contributing to unique subsurface light behavior
Multi-way admixture (e.g. 70% West African + 20% European + 10% East Asian): blended face shapes, hair textures, body proportions reflecting reticulate evolution on the hominin tree
hominin_tree_relation.use_in_prompts: Add as suffix or integrated: '... with {X}% {hominin branch} ancestry expressing as {specific visible traits like brow, limb proportions, melanin distribution}'

skin_science_subsurface.sub_surface_ir_tiger_stripes: subsurface scattering (SSS) with visible 'tiger stripe' patterning (melanin bands or vascular Blaschko-like lines) enhanced in side/raking light or simulated IR; {percentage}% of irradiance penetrates epidermis to scatter in dermis creating soft glow and depth; stripes more pronounced in certain ancestries with dispersed melanin clusters
skin_science_subsurface.melanin_dispersion_and_refraction_of_irr: Eumelanin (brown-black) and pheomelanin (red-yellow) dispersed in stratum basale and spinosum layers at {X}% density for Fitzpatrick skin type; irradiance refraction/absorption: fair skin ~55-65% reflectance with high SSS glow, medium ~30-45%, deep skin ~10-20% reflectance but rich subsurface color from multiple scattering; add 'tiger striping' for micro-variation and realism under film LUTs (e.g. '35% subsurface irradiance refraction with faint tiger-stripe melanin dispersion visible on collarbones and temples in golden hour side light')
skin_science_subsurface.additional_skin_details: pore size/density varying by ancestry and body area, skin thickness (thinner on eyelids, thicker on soles), undertones (blue/pink/yellow/green from blood/ melanin), reaction to light (sheen on high oil, matte on dry, iridescent in certain admixtures)
